name: Watashi ga Sekai o Sukutta Hi
original_name: わたしが世界を救った日
source:
To us, who are breathing our last every moment we are alive, you are beyond a shadow of a doubt a hero.

This is a story of the female protagonist being summoned to another world, becoming a hero and saving the world.

[Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/sp/adventure/game_1708.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
translation:
对于每时每刻都在呼吸着最后一口气的我们来说，你毫无疑问是一位英雄。

这是一个女主角被召唤到另一个世界、成为英雄并拯救世界的故事。

[翻译自[url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/sp/adventure/game_1708.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
